spec_match.rationale: Reproduces the design doc's exact gating order (fenced frame → 'haptics' policy → sticky activation → intensity normalization) with the silent-return semantics stated, and the WebIDL double vs clamp distinction matches the IDL.

interactive.rationale: Live window.fence probe, real featurePolicy introspection, a live navigator.userActivation readout with refresh button, an intensity evaluator, a full pipeline runner, and two reporting iframes — every readout is produced by executing the real platform surface that gate uses.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises live readouts of userActivation and the policy register plus NaN/out-of-range behavior; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers unregistered-policy (explained as flag-coupled, explicitly not browser age), pre-interaction activation stop, NaN TypeError vs finite clamping (executed for real when the API exists, stated-from-IDL when not), and opaque-origin denial as the cross-origin-without-delegation case.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5167864517623808, the explainer's security section, the design doc's gating sections, and the Permissions Policy spec.

conformance.rationale: The suite's haptics-permissions-policy-registered, nonfinite-intensity and out-of-range assertions are this page's contracts; suite verified executing on /conformance/.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright-driven headless Chromium 141: gate readouts render real values (fence undefined, haptics not in the 100+-policy register, hasBeenActive flips true after click); frame A reports fullscreen=true while sandboxed frame B reports false, proving the allowlist mechanism; NaN and 2.5 evaluations verified; pipeline run ends in the honest skip; zero console errors after switching frame B from allow="'none'" (which Chrome logs violation errors for) to an opaque-origin sandbox; both viewport classes read, overflow 0.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the load probe, policy readout, activation reads, the iframe mechanism result (fullscreen=false in B), NaN-throw expectations when executable, and pipeline branches; unexpected throws assert false.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; verdict chips are stone-on-charcoal; run buttons pair background with color; the note block uses the amber-bordered stone pattern.

accessibility.rationale: Each gate is a labelled region with its verdict in text; results go to aria-live outputs; the iframes carry descriptive titles and their results are mirrored into a semantic table, so nothing depends on reading iframe content.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Single-column gate cards, wrapping clamp row, scrollable table wrapper; measured overflow 0 at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the policy gate for real once 'haptics' registers
openQuestions.detail: With WebHaptics enabled, allowsFeature('haptics') should flip true at top level and the sandboxed frame should stay false; add an allow="haptics" delegation iframe at that point and re-record the table. Until then the fullscreen stand-in carries the mechanism demo.

openQuestions.title: Fenced-frame branch is unreachable from a showcase page
openQuestions.detail: The window.fence probe honestly reports 'not in a fenced frame' here; actually demonstrating the suppression would need a fenced-frame embedding harness (Protected Audience), which is out of scope for a static page — a human should decide whether a server-side harness is worth it.

guidanceConsulted.query: permissions policy introspection and delegation for a powerful feature
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Gate powerful features with permissions policy and make delegation explicit via the allow attribute.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The page demonstrates exactly that model: default-self allowlist, introspection via document.featurePolicy, opaque-origin denial, and the allow="haptics" snippet for cross-origin delegation.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce live status updates to screen readers after a button action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Post-interaction results belong in live regions; grouped readouts need text form.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Pipeline and clamp results render into aria-live outputs; every gate verdict is plain text inside its card, and iframe results are mirrored into a table.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive stacked cards without horizontal overflow on narrow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single-column grids with wrapping rows and overflow-x wrappers for tables.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Gate cards are a one-column grid, the clamp row wraps, the delegation table sits in a .table-scroll; measured 0 overflow at 360×740 DPR3.

summary: Edge/failure concept: the four-gate pipeline read from the real platform — fence probe, policy register, live sticky-activation, WebIDL intensity semantics — plus an opaque-origin iframe proving the default-self allowlist mechanism today, with every unsupported branch stated and no fake success.
